newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine forex dealing to close at noon Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Philippine forex dealing to close at noon Tuesday.

text.p: The Bankers Association of the Philippines (BAP) said on Monday the dealing system for Philippine peso/U.S. dollar transactions will be closed at noon (0400 GMT) on Tuesday.
Normal trading will resume on Thursday after the Christmas holiday, the BAP said. Trading usually starts at 8:30 a.m. (0030 GMT) and ends at 5:30 p.m. (0930 GMT).
BAP is the umbrella organisation of commercial banks in the country.
Meanwhile, the Philippine Stock Exchange said it will maintain normal business hours on Tuesday.
